author: WindowLedge
body:
Dear Staff members

Hello I am HappyyElephant (Happy), I am willing to spent most my spare time on Avicus and help the server with any problems that come up. 

Application

* My age is 12 but I believe that I am very experienced 12 year old with the staff role. I have been staff on many servers before up to Co-Owner, I did not get banned/demoted the servers shut down due to keeping the server running...

* My timezone is GMT (Greenwich Mean Time). So yes I am EU which I think will help out the server, because the EU hackers/advertisers that may come on whilst the US staff are asleep so I am willing to either mute/ban them if needed.

* I do have TeamSpeak, I am quite active on it as well as the forms. 

* I do have Skype. I am online on Skype every time I turn on my PC. I will try to do the same with the forms and TeamSpeak.

* I do have a recording software, I use OBS at the moment but I will be downloading Fraps soon.

Criteria 1: Self reflection/evaluation 


* Yes I have quite a big experience of being a staff member on several servers for quite a while.

* My biggest weakness is helping people through BuyCraft e.g. They didn't get something that they purchased, but I will contact and Admin or higher straight away. This would affect my Moderating because it could take some time for the staff to come online and fix it, so the player may get mad.

* My biggest strength is dealing with hackers, through out my time in Minecraft I have occurred with multiple hackers, mainly PVP hackers, so I know when someone is hacking or not... I think this will help my Moderating because I can get rid of  the hackers on Avicus.

* I believe I could help the staff team by... If any player needed assistance or help I would be able to assist them with there needs straight away. Also I think I could help the community by getting rid of the hackers on Avicus. I will also make sure nothing suspicious is happening in the chat.

* In my opinion I believe that a leader needs to be loyal to there people also leaders need to listen and assist there people. I would consider my self to be a leader because, I am always assisting those that need it.

* I think I am distinguish in a way that if someone were to say HappyyElephant in chat I would answer to them straight away even if I have homework to do etc...

* I think when interacting to the community I like to make things funny in stead of serious unless its something quite important.

* I would take all the time I have spare to contribute and help the servers community.



Criteria 2: General situations

* Firstly if they kept coming up on Anti-Cheat I would freeze them then teleport to them immediately to see what they are doing to cause the Anti-Cheat to spam chat. Then if I checked there other accounts and saw that they were banned on those accounts I would then keep him froze whilst I contact a Mod +.

* Firstly I would private message him saying 'Are you joking around yes or no?' then if he doesn't reply I will then contact higher staff or record him doing this to then pass on to higher staff.

* If there was another member of staff at the seen I would then get me him and a Moderator into a TeamSpeak/Skype call to discus how this player was hacking and hopefully the Mod will accept.

* I would straight away screen shot it and send it to staff and put proof that it's that exact staff member.

* I would ask staff members what exactly the decision was, then if I still didn't agree with it I would write a form post saying why it shouldn't happen.

Criteria 3: Other

* It would mean a lot to me because, I have played on this server for over 3 years now so I saw the server develop and grow so it would be a honor to help Avicus expand even more.

* I am extremely passionate about Avicus because I know it has the potential to be a very popular server. Avicus means a lot to me I really like the server.

* I speak a bit of French and German but i'm willing to learn languages such as Netherlands...

* I just want to say I hope everyone did well on their applications and I love the server keep it up <3

Thank you for taking your time to read my application.

-HappyyElephant
